Under the Student Disciplinary Regulations, the first authority is the Appeals Committee (ועדת הערעורים), and the appeal is due within 20 days: "לא יאוחר מעשרים יום מיום מסירת פסק הדין לצדדים" (not later than twenty days from the date of delivery of the judgment to the parties) Disciplinary Regulations §42.

Next step: Submit a reasoned written appeal to the secretary of the Appeals Committee (מזכיר ועדת הערעורים) by the 20-day deadline above, and if you may miss it, add a request for an extension to the same submission.


Appeals lie against any judgment of the disciplinary officer (הממונה על המשמעת) Disciplinary Regulations §41. The appeal goes to the secretary of the Appeals Committee in a written notice that sets out your grounds Disciplinary Regulations §43. It is limited to reviewing the officer's findings and conclusions, and new evidence is admitted only in the cases listed in section 46 Disciplinary Regulations §46.

The 20 days are counted from delivery, and the day of delivery itself is not counted Disciplinary Regulations §60. If the judgment was sent to your university e-mail, it counts as delivered once sent Disciplinary Regulations §61. If it reached you another way, the regulations give no other anchor than delivery, so the day you received it is the one to confirm. The chair of the Appeals Committee may extend periods for recorded special reasons, after hearing the other side, but an extension is not guaranteed Disciplinary Regulations §59.
